Rupee Fluctuates Against US Dollar in Early Trade

The Indian Rupee experienced fluctuations against the US dollar during early trading. Initially, the Rupee fell by 10 paise, reaching 94.86 against the dollar. This decline was observed across multiple reports in early trade. However, the Rupee later recovered, rising by 11 paise to close at 94.65 against the US dollar. One report also noted the Rupee opening 16 paise down at 94.90, coinciding with the dollar hitting a specific mark.
